# ParliamentDiagram

**Class:** `UltraCanvasParliamentDiagram` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasParliamentDiagram.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasParliamentDiagram.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasParliamentDiagram.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Seats by party: hemicycle, circle, Westminster benches, grid

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasParliamentDiagram> CreateParliamentDiagram( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasParliamentDiagram> CreateParliamentDiagram( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, ParliamentLayout layout);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasParliamentDiagram(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### enum `ParliamentLayout`

How the seats are arranged. All layouts render the same party list; they only change where each seat goes.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Hemicycle` | Concentric arcs, parties left to right (Wikipedia |
| `Circle` | style). The arc span is configurable: 180 degrees by default, wider for horseshoe chambers. Concentric full rings, parties clockwise from the top |
| `Westminster` | Two blocks of benches facing each other across an |
| `Grid` | aisle: governing parties on the left, the rest on the right, a speaker's chair at the head of the aisle Rectangular waffle of seats, parties left to right, |

Where the party legend goes

| `Right` | One column to the right of the chamber |
| `Hidden` |  |
